player_prompt.intro:
Jumaxa Player {player_id} ({role}) ukax mayni {num_rounds} p'unchaynïna Matching Pennies pukllaypi.
- Kila p'unchay, llällä [heads] jan ukax [tails] (jan ukax [h], [t]).
- Jumaxa achuyaxa jikxatasiñkama, Player 0 p'unchaynïxapxi; jan ukax Player 1 p'unchaynïxapxi.
Jik'ita llällä ukax mayt'äwixi '[heads]' jan ukax '[tails]' uka formaton.

message.round_match: Jugador 0 isip'iri {choice0}; Jugador 1 isip'iri {choice1}.  Ch'amanchi -> Jugador 0 winsa
message.round_mismatch: Jugador 0 isip'iri {choice0}; Jugador 1 isip'iri {choice1}.  Jan ch'amanchi -> Jugador 1 winsa
